scientific_question: Can the predominantly integrable detector-plane structure left after v183 be converted, without truth or learned parameters, into one physically distinct scalar-projection warm direction that reaches the frozen field, gradient, and observation gates after unchanged CGLS K1?
role: post-open deterministic mechanism diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames; it is neither model training nor fresh generalization
physical_hypothesis: Ideal BOS displacement is the detector-plane gradient of a line-integrated density potential. Instead of directly backprojecting the two displacement components as v182-v183 did, v184 first integrates each camera residual into a zero-mean scalar projection potential, then applies the adjoint of a scalar straight-ray projection in the frozen affine field coordinates.
physical_distinction: v184 is not a new camera partition, another coefficient per v183 block, a second block-Krylov depth, or a change to the physical CGLS step. It changes the observation representation from vector-gradient residual backprojection to detector integration followed by scalar-ray backprojection, while retaining one global observable line-search coefficient and unchanged physical CGLS K1.

post_open_mechanism_diagnostic.claim_boundary: These retrospective values select the scalar-potential mechanism family only. They are not a v184 result, do not set a performance threshold, and do not authorize alternative formulas after v184 is frozen.

projection_potential_primary.name: zero_mean_detector_potential_scalar_ray_jacobi
projection_potential_primary.centered_vector_residual: r=y-A mean_fit in the frozen two-component calibrated-gradient observation layout
projection_potential_primary.detector_coordinates: for each reported camera, use the same 24x24 target-plane u and v cell centers generated from the reported rotation, frozen volume bounds, and camera right/up axes that enter the frozen ray builder
projection_potential_primary.valid_nodes: only rays that intersect the frozen field box; preserve lexicographic u-major then v-minor node order and physical camera identity
projection_potential_primary.gradient_matrix: at every valid node and component, use the immediate central physical-coordinate difference when both neighbors are valid; otherwise use the unique one-sided immediate difference; a node with no neighbor on either side is invalid
projection_potential_primary.potential_problem: for each camera independently, solve min_phi ||G phi-r_camera||_2 subject to sum(phi)=0 using the exact KKT system [[G^T G,1],[1^T,0]]
projection_potential_primary.independent_kkt_solver: numpy.linalg.solve on an independently assembled KKT matrix
projection_potential_primary.potential_gauge: unweighted arithmetic mean over valid detector nodes is exactly zero within 1e-10 relative tolerance
projection_potential_primary.scalar_ray_operator: one trilinear density line integral per valid ray, using the same clipped straight ray, field axes, two-point Gauss quadrature per crossed cell interval, and valid-node order as the calibrated-gradient operator
projection_potential_primary.scalar_camera_centering: subtract each active camera block row mean from the reduced scalar measurement matrix so the scalar prediction uses the same per-camera zero-mean gauge as phi
projection_potential_primary.scalar_reduced_system: N=C P U^T, where P is the scalar ray operator, U is the frozen affine basis, and C subtracts the active-camera block mean
projection_potential_primary.scalar_group_order: active physical cameras in the supplied operator order; camera permutation must only permute scalar blocks
projection_potential_primary.scalar_jacobi_direction: z=g/diag(N^T N); no floor is allowed and every diagonal entry must be finite and strictly positive
projection_potential_primary.observable_image: q=M z using the original calibrated-gradient reduced matrix M=A U^T
projection_potential_primary.observable_coefficient: beta=(r^T q)/(q^T q) with denominator floor 1e-30 only as a fail-closed breakdown check

decision_order: Any identity, isolation, parent, detector-mask, graph-rank, KKT, scalar-operator, adjoint, direction, stationarity, observation-only, mutation, permutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v184 inconclusive.
If projection-potential K1 fails both sensor arms, conclude FAIL_PROJECTION_POTENTIAL_WARM_V184 and close this exact scalar-potential mechanism.
If K1 passes all-nine but fails the frozen five-camera arm, conclude FAIL_FIVE_CAMERA_PROJECTION_POTENTIAL_WARM_V184.
If K1 passes five-camera but fails all-nine, conclude FAIL_VARIABLE_CARDINALITY_PROJECTION_POTENTIAL_WARM_V184.
If K1 passes both sensor arms and K0 also passes both, conclude PASS_CHEAPER_PROJECTION_POTENTIAL_K0_V184 and prefer the cheaper deterministic control.
Only if K1 passes both sensor arms, K0 does not pass both, and all inherited cheaper controls remain failed may v184 conclude PASS_PROJECTION_POTENTIAL_K1_HEADROOM_V184.

No v184 outcome is a learned algorithm, external generalization result, deployable exact-call reduction result, wall/RSS result, curved-ray result, real BOST result, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
